control: fixed fitted reference drift with MP-controlled volatility only
failure_policy: retain and report every seed without seed-specific checkpoint selection
method_label: Deep-MKV-TS (price-only Guyon-Lekeufack reference, Gaussian quasi-likelihood fit)
note: Paper reimplementation for BASSERAS/benchmark. Training settings (w_path=50, w_vol=100, lr=0.002, K=2500, fitted drift, sigma in [1e-3, 0.6], batch 256, 1-layer 96-unit GRU, AdamW, ridge 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5) are Table 6 and Appendix B of main_last.pdf verbatim, cross-checked against the vendored code. The reference is guyon_lekeufack_structural_likelihood, which is what paper Section 2.1 describes: a price-only extension of the Guyon-Lekeufack path-dependent volatility model, estimated by minimising the Gaussian negative log-likelihood, fitted on 80 percent of the training paths and selected on the remaining 20 percent (calibration_fraction=0.8). NOTE: the published Table 1 numbers were generated with the local_gaussian reference (a per-step ridge on the raw complete prefix), whose Reference arm rounds to the published 0.060/0.089/0.068/0.214/0.059; the Guyon-Lekeufack reference is materially stronger, so the Reference row here is expected to sit well below the published one. Author confirmed Guyon-Lekeufack is the correct reference. The run trains 3000 steps and reports the step-2500 checkpoint; with no LR scheduler in the code this is bitwise the paper's K=2500.
selection_basis: no selection; campaign hyperparameters applied verbatim to every seed
